# files from Drive folder names; this file decides what actually ships, where
# it goes, and what the caption reads.
#   source          category/filename as import-photos.sh produces it
#                     cover = ships AND becomes the category tile
#   category        destination category (may differ from where it imported)
#   new_name        filename without extension; becomes the gallery caption
#   note            why — for humans, ignored by the script

# always lands in the same place.
